_comment: Remote accelerator - Out of Range Time Verification, IN-RANGE pulse - STP 8.5.3.2: drive J2-68 (remote accelerator sensor input). Pulse: period 2.0 s, width 0.95 s (950 ms, within the valid window), high 5.0 V, low 0.75 V, high-Z. Pair with a scope capture of pulse rate/width/high/low. Output stays OFF until output_on. Plain numbers in native units: pulse_rate/pulse_width in SECONDS, voltages in V, impedance in ohms (or "INFinity").
name: remote_accel_pulse_950ms
